## `IMakerEditor`

interface · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.IMakerEditor` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

Write side: subtitles, dubs and playback. Implemented in DS-03.

<a id="imakereditor--playasync"></a>

### `Task<MakerResult<MakerSaved>> PlayAsync(string id, string variant, string lang, CancellationToken cancel)`

Makes Satone say the line in the game: `original` = the game's own clip, `dub` = the pack's clip for `lang`.

<a id="imakereditor--savesubtitleasync"></a>

### `Task<MakerResult<MakerSaved>> SaveSubtitleAsync(string packId, string lang, string id, string text, CancellationToken cancel)`

<a id="imakereditor--savevoiceasync"></a>

### `Task<MakerResult<MakerSaved>> SaveVoiceAsync(string packId, string lang, string clip, byte[] wav, CancellationToken cancel)`

Sets (WAV bytes) or removes (null) one dub at `audio/voice/<lang>/<clip>.wav` in a pack, then swaps it in live.

<a id="imakerstudiovoicedefaults"></a>

## `IMakerStudioVoiceDefaults`

interface · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.IMakerStudioVoiceDefaults` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

v2.4: the pack's voice origin and consent. A take created without its own origin and consent copies this default at creation time (`consentSource:"pack"`); later changes do not rewrite existing takes. A separate interface, so existing fakes of [`IMakerStudioDubs`](#imakerstudiodubs) and [`IMakerStudioProjects`](#imakerstudioprojects) still compile.

<a id="makerdefaults"></a>

## `MakerDefaults`

static class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.MakerDefaults` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

The fixed facts and limits of the Pack Maker surface (ticket DS-01, `research/2026-11-07/dub-studio/CONTRACT.md`): paths, body caps, the backend wait, and the error code to HTTP status table. Constants here so the router, the plugin and the tests cannot drift.

<a id="makerdefaults--apipath"></a>

### `const string ApiPath = "/v1/maker"`

The maker API's path prefix; every route is below it.

<a id="makerdefaults--backendgrace"></a>

### `static readonly TimeSpan BackendGrace`

Extra wait on top of [`MakerDefaults.BackendTimeout`](#makerdefaults--backendtimeout) for the backend's own answer.

<a id="makerdefaults--backendtimeout"></a>

### `static readonly TimeSpan BackendTimeout`

How long a backend gets for the main-thread part of a request: the dispatcher's 2 s. The router waits this plus [`MakerDefaults.BackendGrace`](#makerdefaults--backendgrace), so a backend that gave up on the main thread can still answer with its own error, then answers 503 `unavailable` itself.

<a id="makerdefaults--catalogtimeout"></a>

### `static readonly TimeSpan CatalogTimeout`

The whole wait of a Studio catalog read (packs, lines, line, groups): 12 s, so a cold catalog build in a game that runs in the background still answers, and still under the page's own 15 s request timeout.

<a id="makerdefaults--clientname"></a>

### `const string ClientName = "maker"`

The audit line's client name when the request names none (`X-CWY-Client`).

<a id="makerdefaults--defaultlineslimit"></a>

### `const int DefaultLinesLimit = 100`

Lines one `GET /v1/maker/lines` returns when `limit` is not given.

<a id="makerdefaults--eventcapacity"></a>

### `const int EventCapacity = 1024`

Events kept in the maker ring.

<a id="makerdefaults--eventspersecond"></a>

### `const double EventsPerSecond = 10.0`

Event-poll rate per second; the burst is twice this.

<a id="makerdefaults--maxclientlogentries"></a>

### `const int MaxClientLogEntries = 100`

Most entries one `POST /v1/maker/studio/client-log` may carry.

<a id="makerdefaults--maxjsonbytes"></a>

### `const int MaxJsonBytes = 65536`

Largest JSON body accepted (64 KiB).

<a id="makerdefaults--maxlineslimit"></a>

### `const int MaxLinesLimit = 500`

Most lines one `GET /v1/maker/lines` returns.

<a id="makerdefaults--maxsearchchars"></a>

### `const int MaxSearchChars = 200`

Longest search text (`q`) on `GET /v1/maker/lines`, in characters.

<a id="makerdefaults--maxstaticfilebytes"></a>

### `const int MaxStaticFileBytes = 8388608`

Largest static file served from the web folder (8 MiB).

<a id="makerdefaults--maxsubtitlechars"></a>

### `const int MaxSubtitleChars = 2000`

Longest subtitle text, in characters (code points).

<a id="makerdefaults--maxwavbytes"></a>

### `const int MaxWavBytes = 16777216`

Largest voice body accepted (16 MiB).

<a id="makerdefaults--maxwavsamplerate"></a>

### `const int MaxWavSampleRate = 48000`

Highest sample rate of a voice clip.

<a id="makerdefaults--maxwavseconds"></a>

### `const double MaxWavSeconds = 60.0`

Longest voice clip accepted, in seconds.

<a id="makerdefaults--minsubtitlechars"></a>

### `const int MinSubtitleChars = 1`

Shortest subtitle text, in characters (code points).

<a id="makerdefaults--minwavsamplerate"></a>

### `const int MinWavSampleRate = 8000`

Lowest sample rate of a voice clip.

<a id="makerdefaults--readspersecond"></a>

### `const double ReadsPerSecond = 20.0`

Read rate (status, packs, lines) per second; the burst is twice this.

<a id="makerdefaults--tokenmetaname"></a>

### `const string TokenMetaName = "cwyls-maker-token"`

The `name` of the meta element that carries the maker token in `index.html`.

<a id="makerdefaults--webfoldername"></a>

### `const string WebFolderName = "maker"`

The folder under the loader's plugin folder that holds the web app.

<a id="makerdefaults--webpath"></a>

### `const string WebPath = "/maker"`

The web app's path (`GET /maker` redirects to `/maker/`).

<a id="makerdefaults--writespersecond"></a>

### `const double WritesPerSecond = 10.0`

Write and play rate per second; the burst is twice this.

<a id="makerdefaults--isacceptedfetchsite"></a>

### `static bool IsAcceptedFetchSite(string site)`

True for the `Sec-Fetch-Site` values a page of this origin sends: `same-origin`, or `none` (typed or opened address).

**Parameters**

- `site`: The header value.

<a id="makerdefaults--isacceptedhost"></a>

### `static bool IsAcceptedHost(string host, int port)`

The two `Host` values the maker routes accept: `127.0.0.1:<port>` and `localhost:<port>`.

**Parameters**

- `host`: The `Host` header, or null.
- `port`: The port.

<a id="makerdefaults--isacceptedorigin"></a>

### `static bool IsAcceptedOrigin(string origin, int port)`

The two `Origin` values the maker routes accept: `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` and `http://localhost:<port>`.

**Parameters**

- `origin`: The `Origin` header.
- `port`: The port.

<a id="makerdefaults--owns"></a>

### `static bool Owns(string target)`

True when a request target belongs to Pack Maker: `/maker`, anything below `/maker/`, `/v1/maker` or anything below `/v1/maker/` (the query is ignored).

**Parameters**

- `target`: The request target as sent.

<a id="makerdefaults--statusof"></a>

### `static int StatusOf(string code)`

The HTTP status of a maker error code (CONTRACT.md "Errors"); unknown codes are 500.

**Parameters**

- `code`: The code.

<a id="makerdefaults--weburl"></a>

### `static string WebUrl(int port)`

The clean page address: `http://127.0.0.1:7870/maker/`. Launch links append a one-time nonce.

**Parameters**

- `port`: The port.

<a id="makereventring"></a>

## `MakerEventRing`

sealed class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.MakerEventRing` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

Implements: [`IMakerEventSink`](#imakereventsink)

The maker event stream behind `GET /v1/maker/events`: an [`ApiEventRing`](CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.md#apieventring) of [`MakerDefaults.EventCapacity`](#makerdefaults--eventcapacity) events (same sequence numbers, epoch, drop counting and long-poll as `/v1/events`) that the game adapters publish into through [`MakerBackends.Publish`](#makerbackends--publish). Data members are copied as scalars only (strings, whole and decimal numbers, booleans, null); anything else is written as null, so an adapter can never put an object graph or game data on the wire by accident. Thread-safe; [`MakerEventRing.Publish`](#makereventring--publish) never throws.

<a id="makereventring--ctor"></a>

### `MakerEventRing(int capacity = 1024, Func<DateTimeOffset> now = null, Action<string> diagnostics = null)`

Creates an empty stream.

**Parameters**

- `capacity`: Events kept; at least 1.
- `now`: Wall clock for event times; null means `DateTimeOffset.Now`.
- `diagnostics`: Where a refused or failed publish is reported (once per 100), or null.

<a id="makereventring--refused"></a>

### `long Refused { get; }`

Publishes that were refused (no type) or failed.

<a id="makereventring--ring"></a>

### `ApiEventRing Ring { get; }`

The ring the events route reads.

<a id="makereventring--close"></a>

### `void Close()`

Stops recording and wakes every waiting reader.

<a id="makereventring--publish"></a>

### `void Publish(string type, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object> data)`

Records one event. `data` holds strings, numbers, booleans or null only. Safe from any thread; never throws.

<a id="makergameactivity"></a>

## `MakerGameActivity`

sealed class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.MakerGameActivity` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

Thread-safe cached game activity for Studio v2. Unity callbacks and the main-thread busy poll write it; HTTP workers only take snapshots. Focus, pause and busy remain independent nullable facts.

<a id="makergameactivity--ctor"></a>

### `MakerGameActivity(IApiClock clock, TimeSpan staleAfter)`

Creates an unknown, stale snapshot.

**Parameters**

- `clock`: Monotonic and wall clock.
- `staleAfter`: Age after which [`MakerGameActivitySnapshot.Stale`](#makergameactivitysnapshot--stale) is true.

<a id="makergameactivity--heartbeat"></a>

### `void Heartbeat()`

Refreshes the observation age without changing any fact or publishing a transition.

<a id="makergameactivity--observebusy"></a>

### `bool ObserveBusy(bool? busy, string reason)`

Records the main-thread playback poll. Null means busy is unknown; `reason` may explain why. Returns true when the busy fact or its reason changed.

<a id="makergameactivity--observefocus"></a>

### `bool ObserveFocus(bool focused)`

Records a Unity focus callback. Returns true only when the focus value changed.

<a id="makergameactivity--observepause"></a>

### `bool ObservePause(bool paused)`

Records a Unity pause callback. Returns true only when the pause value changed.

<a id="makerrequesttrace"></a>

## `MakerRequestTrace`

sealed class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.MakerRequestTrace` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

Per-request phase timings of one Pack Maker backend call (`maker trace on`). The router makes one per backend call and makes it the ambient trace of that call (it flows through the call's awaits); the backends mark their phases with [`MakerRequestTrace.Phase`](#makerrequesttrace--phase), which costs nothing when no trace is ambient. The router always reads it on a timeout (which phase was still running) and, with [`MakerRequestTrace.Enabled`](#makerrequesttrace--enabled), for the per-request `MAKER-TRACE` line. Thread-safe: a phase may end on the main thread while the request thread reads the trace after a timeout.

<a id="makerrequesttrace--current"></a>

### `static MakerRequestTrace Current { get; }`

The trace of the backend call running on this flow, or null.

<a id="makerrequesttrace--elapsedms"></a>

### `double ElapsedMs { get; }`

Milliseconds since the trace was made.

<a id="makerrequesttrace--enabled"></a>

### `static bool Enabled { get; set; }`

True while `maker trace on`: every Pack Maker request writes one `MAKER-TRACE` line.

<a id="makerrequesttrace--add"></a>

### `void Add(string name, double ms)`

Records a finished phase (any thread). Repeated names add up.

**Parameters**

- `name`: The phase.
- `ms`: Its duration.

<a id="makerrequesttrace--begin"></a>

### `void Begin(string name)`

Opens a phase on this trace (any thread).

**Parameters**

- `name`: The phase.

<a id="makerrequesttrace--end"></a>

### `void End(string name)`

Closes the innermost open phase called `name` and records its duration (any thread).

**Parameters**

- `name`: The phase.

<a id="makerrequesttrace--format"></a>

### `static string Format(double ms)`

Milliseconds with one decimal, invariant culture.

**Parameters**

- `ms`: Milliseconds.

<a id="makerrequesttrace--mssince"></a>

### `static double MsSince(long from)`

Stopwatch ticks in milliseconds.

**Parameters**

- `from`: A `Stopwatch.GetTimestamp` value.

<a id="makerrequesttrace--note"></a>

### `static void Note(string name, double ms)`

Records a finished phase of the ambient trace (no-op when none).

**Parameters**

- `name`: The phase.
- `ms`: Its duration.

<a id="makerrequesttrace--phase"></a>

### `static MakerRequestTrace.PhaseScope Phase(string name)`

Starts a phase of the ambient trace; dispose to end it. Free (no allocation) when no trace is ambient.

**Parameters**

- `name`: A short constant name, e.g. `catalog.gate`.

<a id="makerrequesttrace--phases"></a>

### `string Phases()`

The finished phases in order: `slot=0.2 catalog.gate=0.0 main.wait=12.3 ...`; `-` when none.

<a id="makerrequesttrace--restore"></a>

### `static void Restore(MakerRequestTrace previous)`

Puts back the trace [`MakerRequestTrace.Use`](#makerrequesttrace--use) replaced.

**Parameters**

- `previous`: What [`MakerRequestTrace.Use`](#makerrequesttrace--use) returned.

<a id="makerrequesttrace--running"></a>

### `string Running()`

The phases still open, innermost last, with how long each has run: `catalog.view(2950.1)>main.wait(2940.0)`; `-` when none.

<a id="makerrequesttrace--use"></a>

### `static MakerRequestTrace Use(MakerRequestTrace trace)`

Makes `trace` the ambient trace of this flow; returns the previous one for [`MakerRequestTrace.Restore`](#makerrequesttrace--restore).

**Parameters**

- `trace`: The trace, or null.

<a id="makerrouter"></a>

## `MakerRouter`

sealed class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.MakerRouter` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

Pack Maker's request pipeline (ticket DS-01, CONTRACT.md): the web app under `/maker/` and the `/v1/maker/*` routes. It runs inside the API's listener ([`ApiRouter.UseMaker`](CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.md#apirouter--usemaker)) or on a maker-only listener ([`MakerRouter.Handle`](#makerrouter--handle)) when `[Api] Enabled=false`. Order: stopping (503) → `Host` is accepted by the Maker router (the listener promises only `127.0.0.1:<port>`) (421) → `Origin`, if present, is this page's own and `Sec-Fetch-Site`, if present, is `same-origin` or `none` (403 `forbidden_origin`) → for the page a one-time launch link or browser session; for `/v1/maker/*` the maker token in constant time (401) → route and segments (404/400) → rate limit (429) → query and body (400/413/415) → backend (503 when none) with the main-thread timeout. Never sends CORS headers. Never throws from [`MakerRouter.Handle`](#makerrouter--handle); never touches Unity (the backends hop to the main thread themselves); never logs the token, a header value or a body.

<a id="makerrouter--ctor"></a>

### `MakerRouter(ApiToken token, MakerRouterOptions options)`

Creates a router.

**Parameters**

- `token`: The maker token (per start; not the API's access key).
- `options`: The dependencies.

**Exceptions**

- `ArgumentNullException`: A required argument is null.
- `ArgumentException`: The port is out of range.

<a id="makerrouter--clientlogsegment"></a>

### `const string ClientLogSegment = "client-log"`

The path segment of the page's log route under `/v1/maker/studio/`.

<a id="makerrouter--tracesys"></a>

### `const string TraceSys = "maker"`

The bus subsystem of these lines.

<a id="makerrouter--backendcalls"></a>

### `int BackendCalls { get; }`

Backend calls still running, including ones that already timed out.

<a id="makerrouter--counters"></a>

### `ApiCounters Counters { get; }`

Requests answered by [`MakerRouter.Handle`](#makerrouter--handle) (the maker-only listener).

<a id="makerrouter--events"></a>

### `MakerEventRing Events { get; }`

The event stream (install it with [`MakerBackends.UseEvents`](#makerbackends--useevents)).

<a id="makerrouter--isstopping"></a>

### `bool IsStopping { get; }`

True once [`MakerRouter.BeginStop`](#makerrouter--beginstop) was called.

<a id="makerrouter--port"></a>

The port.

Long-polls waiting right now.

<a id="makerrouter--webroot"></a>

### `string WebRoot { get; }`

The web app folder, or null.

<a id="makerrouter--beginstop"></a>

### `void BeginStop()`

Answers 503 from now on, wakes every long-poll and cancels backend calls in flight.

<a id="makerrouter--createopenurl"></a>

### `string CreateOpenUrl()`

Mints a single-use browser launch URL, valid for 60 seconds. Each call makes a fresh link; at most 16 unconsumed links are retained. Only the command's caller receives it, never request logs. The browser exchanges it for an HttpOnly, host-only session cookie under /maker/ and redirects to the clean page URL. The cookie permits reloads until this router stops.

**Exceptions**

- `InvalidOperationException`: Pack Maker is closing.

<a id="makerrouter--handle"></a>

### `ApiResponse Handle(ApiRequest request)`

Handles one request on the maker-only listener: maker targets go through [`MakerRouter.Route`](#makerrouter--route), anything else is 404. Never throws; writes exactly one audit record.

**Parameters**

- `request`: The request.

<a id="makerrouter--route"></a>

### `ApiResponse Route(ApiRequest r, ApiAuditRecord audit)`

Answers one Pack Maker request (a target [`MakerDefaults.Owns`](#makerdefaults--owns) accepts) and fills the audit record's client and authentication; the caller writes the record. Used by [`ApiRouter`](CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.md#apirouter) (which owns the audit and the 500 on an exception there) and by [`MakerRouter.Handle`](#makerrouter--handle).

**Parameters**

- `r`: The request.
- `audit`: The audit record to fill.

<a id="makerstaticfiles"></a>

## `MakerStaticFiles`

static class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.MakerStaticFiles` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

The web app's files under `BepInEx/plugins/CwyLsModLoader/maker/`, served at `/maker/`. Strict: every path segment is `[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*` (so no `..`, no dotfiles, no `_drafts`, no backslash or percent sign), only known file types are served, the resolved path must stay inside the folder, links are not followed, and files over [`MakerDefaults.MaxStaticFileBytes`](#makerdefaults--maxstaticfilebytes) are refused. `index.html` at the top gets the per-start token, only after the router authenticates the browser session, as `<meta name="cwyls-maker-token" content="…">` right after `<head>`. Files are read on each request (no cache), so a rebuilt web app shows at once.

<a id="makerstaticfiles--indexfile"></a>

### `const string IndexFile = "index.html"`

The page the bare `/maker/` serves.

<a id="makerstaticfiles--contenttypeof"></a>

### `static string ContentTypeOf(string fileName)`

The `Content-Type` for a file name, or null when the type is not served.

**Parameters**

- `fileName`: The file name.

<a id="makerstaticfiles--injecttoken"></a>

### `static byte[] InjectToken(byte[] html, string token)`

Puts `<meta name="cwyls-maker-token" content="…">` right after the opening `<head…>` tag (so it is the first such meta in the document); after the doctype when there is no head element; at the very start otherwise. The token is hex, so it needs no escaping.

**Parameters**

- `html`: The page as UTF-8 bytes.
- `token`: The token (64 hex characters).

<a id="makerstaticfiles--read"></a>

### `static MakerStaticStatus Read(string webRoot, string relative, string token, out byte[] bytes, out string contentType, out string problem)`

Reads one file of the web app.

**Parameters**

- `webRoot`: The web folder, or null when unknown.
- `relative`: The path below `/maker/` without the query (empty = `index.html`).
- `token`: The maker token to inject into the top `index.html`, or null for none.
- `bytes`: The file (with the token for the index); empty unless [`MakerStaticStatus.Ok`](#makerstaticstatus--ok).
- `contentType`: The type to send; empty unless [`MakerStaticStatus.Ok`](#makerstaticstatus--ok).
- `problem`: Why it was not served; empty on success. Never contains the token.

<a id="makerstaticstatus"></a>

## `MakerStaticStatus`

enum · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.MakerStaticStatus` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

What [`MakerStaticFiles.Read`](#makerstaticfiles--read) found.

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="makerstaticstatus--ok"></a>`Ok` | 0 | The file was read. |
| <a id="makerstaticstatus--badpath"></a>`BadPath` | 1 | The path is not a plain path into the web folder (traversal, dotfile, odd character): 400. |
| <a id="makerstaticstatus--notfound"></a>`NotFound` | 2 | No such file, or a type that is not served: 404. |
| <a id="makerstaticstatus--unavailable"></a>`Unavailable` | 3 | The web folder is missing or the file could not be read: 503. |

<a id="makerstudioplayrequest"></a>

## `MakerStudioPlayRequest`

sealed class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.MakerStudioPlayRequest` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

Transient Studio playback; never implicitly saves text or publishes a take.

<a id="makerstudioplayrequest--expectedrevision"></a>

### `string ExpectedRevision { get; set; }`

Optional line revision precondition; requires [`MakerStudioPlayRequest.PackId`](#makerstudioplayrequest--packid).

<a id="makerstudioplayrequest--id"></a>

### `string Id { get; set; }`

The voiced story line to play; normal story and DLC scope checks apply.

<a id="makerstudioplayrequest--lang"></a>

### `string Lang { get; set; }`

Subtitle and dub language; aliases are canonicalized before playback.

<a id="makerstudioplayrequest--packid"></a>

### `string PackId { get; set; }`

Selected loaded pack; required and editable for `sub`. Pending packs require a restart.

<a id="makerstudioplayrequest--variant"></a>

### `string Variant { get; set; }`

`original`: game voice and text; `dub`: pack voice and subtitle; `sub`: original voice with the selected pack's current subtitle for [`MakerStudioPlayRequest.Lang`](#makerstudioplayrequest--lang). Subtitle lookup falls back to the effective subtitle, then the game's text, as with `dub`.

<a id="makersurface"></a>

## `MakerSurface`

sealed class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.MakerSurface` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

One Pack Maker session from the `maker` command to its close: a fresh token (32 random bytes as hex, held in memory only, never logged), the event ring and the router. Unity-free so its lifecycle is tested; the plugin owns the listener (its own, or the API's through [`ApiRouter.UseMaker`](CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.md#apirouter--usemaker)) and the browser.

<a id="makersurface--ctor"></a>

### `MakerSurface(MakerRouterOptions options, ApiToken token = null)`

Creates a session (nothing listens and no events are taken yet).

**Parameters**

- `options`: The router options; [`MakerRouterOptions.Events`](#makerrouteroptions--events) is filled when null.
- `token`: The token; null mints a new one (tests pass their own).

<a id="makersurface--events"></a>

### `MakerEventRing Events { get; }`

The event stream the adapters publish into while the session is open.

<a id="makersurface--isopen"></a>

### `bool IsOpen { get; }`

True between [`MakerSurface.Open`](#makersurface--open) and [`MakerSurface.Close`](#makersurface--close).

<a id="makersurface--router"></a>

### `MakerRouter Router { get; }`

The request pipeline.

<a id="makersurface--tokenid"></a>

### `string TokenId { get; }`

The token's non-secret id, for status lines.

<a id="makersurface--url"></a>

### `string Url { get; }`

The clean page address (opening it requires a launch link or an existing browser session).

<a id="makersurface--close"></a>

### `void Close()`

Ends the session: the router answers 503, long-polls wake, backend calls are cancelled, and the event slot is emptied when it still holds this session's ring. Idempotent.

<a id="makersurface--open"></a>

### `void Open()`

Installs [`MakerSurface.Events`](#makersurface--events) as [`MakerBackends.Events`](#makerbackends--events), so the adapters' events reach the page.

<a id="makerwavcheck"></a>

## `MakerWavCheck`

static class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.MakerWavCheck` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

The voice body check of the request rules: reads the RIFF chunk headers only (no samples are decoded, so a 16 MiB upload costs no second copy here) and decides format and length. A header that does not add up (two 'fmt ' or 'data' chunks, chunks past the RIFF size, a byte rate or block align that contradicts the format, a partial last frame) is 415, like any other unsupported body (DS-10a). The editor (DS-03) decodes the clip itself; this check only keeps what can never be a dub away from it. An empty body is the router's 400 (a malformed request) and never reaches this check. Pure; never throws.

<a id="makerwavcheck--check"></a>

### `static MakerWavVerdict Check(byte[] bytes, out double durationSec, out string problem)`

Checks a voice body.

**Parameters**

- `bytes`: The whole body.
- `durationSec`: The playing time when the format is readable; 0 otherwise.
- `problem`: One sentence for a creator when the verdict is not [`MakerWavVerdict.Ok`](#makerwavverdict--ok).

---

<a id="makerwavverdict"></a>

## `MakerWavVerdict`

enum · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Api.Maker.MakerWavVerdict` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

How a voice body fared against the request rules.

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="makerwavverdict--ok"></a>`Ok` | 0 | A 16-bit PCM WAV, mono or stereo, 8-48 kHz, at most 60 s. |
| <a id="makerwavverdict--unsupported"></a>`Unsupported` | 2 | Not a supported WAV: not RIFF/WAVE at all, a truncated or malformed header, or a format the game cannot take (encoding, bit depth, channels, rate): 415 `unsupported_media_type` (contract ruling, DS-01). |
| <a id="makerwavverdict--toolong"></a>`TooLong` | 3 | Longer than [`MakerDefaults.MaxWavSeconds`](#makerdefaults--maxwavseconds): 413 `too_large`. |
